description: Use this when the user wants countries ranked on one World Bank indicator for a year, optionally within a region or income group, for example the highest life expectancy in Sub-Saharan Africa. Aggregates are excluded; ties share a rank; countries without a value are listed separately. Returns the top entries and XLSX, CSV and PDF files with the full ranking. Does not combine indicators into a score.

income_group.description: World Bank income group, e.g. HIC for high income, UMC upper middle, LMC lower middle, LIC low income.

indicator.description: World Development Indicators code or common name, e.g. SP.DYN.LE00.IN or life expectancy.

limit.description: How many top entries to show in chat, 1 to 50, e.g. 10. Files hold the full ranking. Default 20.

order.description: desc for highest first (default), asc for lowest first, e.g. asc.

region.description: World Bank region code, e.g. SSF for Sub-Saharan Africa, ECS Europe & Central Asia, EAS East Asia & Pacific, LCN Latin America & Caribbean, MEA Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan, NAC North America, SAS South Asia.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2022. Leave out to use the latest year in which at least half of the filtered countries have a value.

name: rank_countries
title: Rank countries
